name: Women in Blue
description: In 1971, four women defy ultraconservative norms and join Mexico's first female police force—only to discover that it's a publicity stunt to distract the media from a serial killer. As the body count grows, they make a pact to bring the killer to justice.

videos.title: María
videos.overview: As a serial killer targeting women terrorizes the city, María, Valentina, Gabina, and Ángeles join the first female police force.

videos.title: Paola
videos.overview: María and the other Azules stumble upon a new victim of the Undresser and watch as a man they believe is innocent gets arrested.

videos.title: Norma
videos.overview: Dissatisfied with the detectives' conclusions, the Azules conduct their own investigation off the books.

videos.title: Alma
videos.overview: Another Undresser victim is found, confirming the Azules' suspicions. Their investigation points detectives to a new suspect.

videos.title: Ángeles
videos.overview: Romandía gets pulled into the investigation as the Azules uncover a clue that may reveal the Undresser's identity.

videos.title: Laura
videos.overview: The detectives take drastic measures to find answers. María seeks the help of someone who can offer new insight: a convicted serial killer.

videos.title: Dora
videos.overview: The Azules turn their attention to unsolved murders, hoping to find a connection to the Undresser.

videos.title: Rosa
videos.overview: María and Ángeles interview the adopted son of a woman named Rosa, who the Azules believe may have been the Undresser's first victim.

videos.title: Gabina
videos.overview: The Azules work with the detectives to stage a trap for the man they think is the Undresser—but things don't go as planned.

videos.title: Valentina
videos.overview: The Azules pull their resources together to try and save one of their own, putting the future of the female police force at risk.

videos.title: Mauricio
videos.overview: New lieutenant María and the Azules set their sights on investigating the murder of a college student.

videos.title: Filiberto
videos.overview: An unexpected clue links the first victim with a second, kicking off a theory about targeted attacks.

videos.title: Quintanilla
videos.overview: After interrogating the surviving student activists, it's clear one of them is hiding something.

videos.title: Arizmendi
videos.overview: Detectives are convinced they know who's behind the killing of dirty cops. The Azules aren't so sure.

videos.title: Lozano
videos.overview: When another detective goes missing, fear sets in. María's night out with her daughter takes a turn.

videos.title: Gilberto
videos.overview: Anti-police sentiment continues to grow in the wake of the Executioner's latest victims.

videos.title: Gerardo
videos.overview: An act of desperation forces Gerardo's hand—and threatens Gabina's friendship with Valentina.

videos.title: Goyo
videos.overview: The Azules race to connect the dots before the Executioner strikes again.
